audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers had Level 3 as Gangplank, Level 6 as Gangplank, First item as Skill and 2+ items as Gangplank; the packet chart reads Skill, Skill, Gangplank, Yone for those rows and every whys[] row already matches the packet.
audit.why: The mirror was rebuilt onto the packet chart, so this side must be its inverse or the two pages disagree row for row.
audit.corrected: Gangplank, Gangplank, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gangplank, Yone — he owns the first levels, the middle is a spacing contest, his first-item keg burst spikes, and you take over at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: No real numbers on either side's spikes; the level 6 row was written as a Gangplank power flip on the strength of the wrong ultimate description.
audit.why: Cannon Barrage is 160/140/120s and deals true damage; Remove Scurvy is 22/20/18/16/14s; Parrrley is 4.5s flat; Powder Keg has no cooldown and no cost. Your own Soul Unbound falls 22s to 10s across ranks.
audit.corrected: His spikes are the Sheen item and every Remove Scurvy coming back up; yours are Soul Unbound's shrinking cooldown and the first crit item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fate Sealed described as setting up 'team knockups nothing can dodge'; Powder Keg described as a tracked cooldown to wait out.
audit.why: Fate Sealed blinks behind the LAST champion in a line and pulls everyone hit toward Yone — there is no airborne. Powder Keg has cooldown 0 and cost 0, so there is no window where it is 'down'; the counterplay is popping barrels, not tracking a timer. Cannon Barrage deals true damage, so armour and MR do nothing against it.
audit.corrected: Pop each keg as it arms — it costs him nothing to replace, so waiting for it to be down never happens. His real gaps are Remove Scurvy at 22s rank 1 and Parrrley at 4.5s. Fate Sealed pulls rather than knocks up.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds line despite Remove Scurvy being the ability that decides extended trades.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy heals as well as cleansing; anti-heal is the item answer, and stacking resistances is the wrong answer to a true-damage ultimate.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds timing beats Remove Scurvy; do not buy resistances expecting them to help against Cannon Barrage.

edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind the last enemy and pulls — it never knocks up. Cannon Barrage is 160s at rank 1, so bait it before you commit.
